text:
maya: dropping a compact mock for the model catalog compare table. main idea: keep single-line rows but add a persistent micro-affordance to show metrics and performance badges on focus/hover. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-catalog-compare
sam: Nice. Love the lower density. Quick question: what does the micro-affordance look like? a dot? chevron? tiny badge?
maya: thinking a 6px dot + 'View metrics' SR label. visible on hover/focus only. keeps scanning clean but still discoverable.
jing: accessibility nit: 6px dot alone isn't keyboard discoverable. need a focusable element -> 44px tappable target. Also contrast on the dot needs checking (small target requires higher contrast).
alex: perf note: don't mount the full metric tooltip for every row. render a lightweight aria-hidden preview and lazy-load charts when inspector opens. also use transform+opacity for reveal to avoid reflow.
len: copy: prefer 'View metrics' over 'Show metrics' or 'Open metrics' — clearer that it's an action. For badges, we should include alt text like 'Latency: 120ms' for SR users.
sam: microcopy: tooltip should be short: 'View metrics — Enter'. SR text: 'Press Enter to open metrics panel for this model version.'
jing: contrast: the small performance badge uses #9CA3AF on white, that's borderline. bump to #374151 or add 1px stroke for readability at small sizes.
maya: will update: 44px hit area, accessible affordance focusable, transform-based reveal, change microcopy to 'View metrics', add SR hint. I'll post updated figma and a staging preview.
PreviewBot: Staging preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/compact-catalog-2305008000
alex: also add prefers-reduced-motion support (instant toggle). virtualize the table for large catalogs so keyboard nav doesn't jump.
maya: thanks — iterating now. I'll include the ARIA attributes (aria-controls/aria-expanded/aria-describedby) in the spec so QA has strings to run checks against.
